description: Create a reviewed brief with required brand_id, source_topic_id when starting from a saved topic, and pillar_id when available. The API approves this supplied brief, making it ready for item generation. Optional facts (at most 20, at most 5 must_use) are user-supplied claims the article cites; they need the v2 article pipeline (409 article_pipeline_not_v2 otherwise) and a refused fact is a 422 with nothing saved. Optional article_spec marks elements (citations, stats, key_takeaways, quotes, faq, comparison_table, toc, relevant_links, products) required, optional or off and sets citation, FAQ, length and voice targets; omit it for the standard article. A required source must also be in source_urls.

items.description:
A fact you supply for the article to cite (request).

One line of plain text, at most 200 characters, with no Markdown, HTML,
links or ``[[``/``]]``. ``source_url`` is optional: its page is fetched
at generation and the fact is cited to it only when the page states every
figure and name in the fact; otherwise the fact is used without a link
(a regulated workspace leaves it out). A ``source_url`` the brand source
policy or the workspace's blocked hosts refuse is a 422
(``user_fact_source_url_ineligible``), and workspaces with
regulated-content settings must supply one (422
``user_fact_source_url_required``). Generation applies these rules again
and leaves out a fact that no longer meets them. At most 20 facts, at
most 5 with ``priority=must_use``.
